summary: B1 revised Explore review approved. All eight prior blocking findings are resolved. The B1 plan now has a single frozen ten-Action Catalog, a provider-neutral ResultRef boundary, a field-level ownership matrix for all eleven domain objects, exact Delivery/Change/Run state sets and structural transition tables, and a fixture-only Run-ID parse/validate/allocate contract that rejects malformed, duplicate, non-monotonic, out-of-range, and exhausted NNN values while preserving allowed gaps. The scope remains B1-only and does not implement C1 persistence/adapters, D1 Policy, code, or Full Test.

resolvedFindings.resolution: The formal catalog consistently contains the frozen ten Change Actions; change-checkpoint is retained only as a Git boundary.
ResultRef is provider-neutral and no longer requires a Run path.
The Review focus uses the same ten-Action criterion as the catalog and acceptance checks.
The object-contract matrix defines ownership, minimum fields, and validation direction for all eleven required objects.
RunStatus is limited to pending, completed, failed, and cancelled; in-progress is confined to ActionResult execution status.
Delivery, Change, and Run all have structural transition tables and exhaustive matrix-test direction; semantic preconditions remain D1 Policy work.
Run-ID parsing, Delivery-wide uniqueness, monotonicity, gap preservation, and three-digit exhaustion are specified as pure B1 functions using fixtures.
Candidate NNN validation now rejects every non-finite, non-integer, or out-of-range value before monotonicity is evaluated.
